changeSet.sql: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'HelpMenu') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[HelpMenu]( [ID] [int] NOT NULL IDENTITY(1, 1), [Name] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Description] [nvarchar](500) NULL, [Url] [varchar](250) NOT NULL, [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [isEditable] [bit] NOT NULL, [visibilty] [int] NOT NULL, [order] [int] NOT NULL) END
changeSet.rollback: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'HelpMenu') BEGIN DROP TABLE [dbo].[HelpMenu] END
